commits.subject: C4 F3: broaden verified practice and trigger contexts

scope: F3 practice/bank breadth and CPU tests only
implementation: One native verified-example visitor for current, imported LS and optional PLAN_FIX banks; no first-three limit.
Practice includes all usable admitted cooperative contexts, preserves each original snapshot and per-seed CRN, deduplicates restart contexts and rotates through less-used contexts before repetition.
Trigger supervision scans retained observable frames for each acting member, adjusts remaining onset/hold, and includes legacy and newly supplied verified plans.
Practice B/R family quotas match; R follows B realized family sequence after normal replacements. Trigger CE uses equal supported-family mass and equal within-family context mass in both arms.
Explicit mismatch refusal prevents unverified labels or silent B/R family-distribution drift.
Frozen plans, snapshot hashes, context identities, family counts and normalized CE family mass provide auditable breadth receipts.
A bypasses bank/PLAN_FIX readers and practice selection; frozen low-level parameters remain untouched in actual CPU trigger updates.

api.bank_breadth.inputs: inputs(cfg) -> current and PLAN_FIX bank run_root/replay_sources entries
api.bank_breadth.visit: visit(cfg, arm, consumer) -> callback for every usable verified example; A is a no-op
api.bank_breadth.practice_pool: practice_pool(cfg, arm) -> distinct verified restart contexts with snapshot lookup/hash, family and seed provenance
api.bank_breadth.observable_contexts: observable_contexts(policy, plan, pairs, frames, t0=...) -> earliest usable context/remaining library target per acting member
api.practice_starts.plan_for_update: Added breadth_cfg=cfg; wired in production collection and matched-A safety-reference plan lookup
api.practice_starts.load_snapshot: Supports native imported LS and external verified-bank snapshot_lookup, exact CRN replication and frozen snapshot hash verification
api.launch_production.bank_move_supervision: All usable verified contexts; normalized common family distribution and context-identity receipts

handoff.outputs: [{run_root: <verified bank run root>, replay_sources: {B: [<LS source>], R: [<LS source>]}}]
handoff.empty_or_missing: Use the current bank and configured replay_sources
handoff.verification: Handoff is not admission evidence: existing native confirmation, confidence/safety, branch tape hash and effective/observable target checks still apply

final_suite.result: 212 passed, 1 skipped, 1 failed; the only failure was the new wiring test comparing against cfg without the existing runtime update=1 field
final_suite.resolution: Corrected that test expectation to dict(cfg, update=1); production code unchanged

tests.earlier_complete_regression: 211 passed, 1 skipped before the final realized-family/report tests and wiring assertion were added
tests.skip_reason: Existing file-symlink privilege test skips on Windows; exercised by cpuV qualification
coverage: Native on-disk confidence/safety admission rejects non-admitted examples and changed branch tapes
Six distinct verified plans times two admitted seeds enter the pool, including LS-imported and PLAN_FIX library/variety fixture banks
Native LS pending/snapshot/episode reconstruction and exact seed-2 generator restoration
Rotation across all 11 available synthetic contexts, deterministic frozen-plan reuse, repeat caps and unequal B/R bank sizes
R matches realized B family sequence after a failed practice slot becomes normal
Actual trigger CE decreases over eight contexts with equal family mass despite seven-to-one example/legacy-weight skew
Missing first frame is recovered through later observable context; hidden partner remains ineligible
Frozen base weights/gradients and A bank-reader isolation
Realized context identity, distinct-count and family histograms

integration_requirements: Publish and stage PLAN_FIX/S-VARIETY outputs using the documented verified-bank handoff contract when those outputs exist.
Apply at a new update boundary: pre-F3 frozen plans are preserved and refused for same-update F3 reuse.
Provide verified family support in both B and R; runtime explicitly rejects unequal support instead of weakening verification or fairness.
open_issues: Real PLAN_FIX/S-VARIETY outputs and current production B/R usable family support were not inspected in this CPU-only worktree task; the hook is validated with native-format CPU fixture banks.
Legacy native-plan projection remains approximate; only a separately re-verified library plan certifies the library action's realized outcome.
